$description: Print format presets (guidelines/print/README.md, visual designer 2026-11-20). margin = the content margin in mm: 8% of the short side of the finished piece (the folded panel for brochures), never less than 1.5 × safe (visual designer, 2026-11-20). title, supporting, titleMin, supportingMin = text in pt for one-page promos; the Min values are the smallest allowed, for space imagery; titleCover is the title on a front that holds only the logo, title and image (proposed, to confirm: visual designer, 2026-11-20). Every text size is a step of the type set read as pt (1 px step = 1 pt): 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 104, 128, 160, 200, plus two print-only steps: 10 (body copy on small formats) and 8 (legal text, footers and small print only) (visual designer, 2026-11-20). Starting points only: the printer's spec sheet always overrides them. Sizes in mm. trim = finished size (width, height); bleed and safe are per side; panels are the widths of each panel left to right, laid out flat; minDpi is the lowest image resolution at final size. Default bleed and safe values are common print practice, not from the Brand Guide.

bleed.$description: mm per side (3.175 for US formats, 1/8 in)

safe.$description: mm inside the trim, per side: the printer's cutting tolerance, not the margin

margin.$value: 8% of the short side, at least 1.5 × safe
margin.$description: The content margin (text, logo, button, QR code, headshots), from the trim. Each format has its own value in mm (visual designer, 2026-11-20)

minDpi.$description: Read up close: flyers, brochures, cards

fileType.$description: Unless the printer asks for another

color.$description: Always the printer's CMYK profile, from the spec. Ask for it

flyer-a6.name: Flyer A6
flyer-a6.$description: Added by the visual designer, 2026-11-20. titleCover: the title on a front that holds only the logo, title and image (two-sided pieces), about 1.45 × title. Body copy uses the print-only 10 pt step.

brochure-a4-bifold.name: Brochure A4 bi-fold
brochure-a4-bifold.$description: Laid out flat: two pages per side (outside and inside). Safe area on both sides of the fold.

brochure-a4-trifold.name: Brochure A4 tri-fold (roll fold)
brochure-a4-trifold.$description: Laid out flat, landscape. The panel that folds in is 3 mm narrower so it closes cleanly; the printer's panel sizes win.

rollup-850x2000.name: Roll-up 850 × 2000
rollup-850x2000.$description: hiddenBottom: the part that rolls into the base (vendors use 100 to 200 mm). Nothing important in it; the vendor's spec wins.

booth.name: Booth graphics
booth.$description: In progress, being tested (visual designer, 2026-11-20). No default size: every booth part (backwall, counter, header, banner) comes from the vendor's spec.

print-pdf.name: Print PDF (for screen)
print-pdf.$description: A PDF that is read on screen or printed at the office (one-pagers, guides): no bleed, no crop marks, no CMYK. US Letter (215.9 × 279.4) when asked.
